system.description:
You don't know the source of your powers: they either just manifested one day, or hint at a bigger mystery.

Powers

Assign all the dice you rolled at the end of the background step to any of the following powers:

• Select from Elemental/Energy powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Self Control powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Abilities

Gain two of these Yellow abilities, each using a different power:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.Zj4WbuK0hTdHRxUM]{Brainstorm}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.HqNyyLvOXHDEXDnX]{Strange Enhancement}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.9ydsxJb3dZTE6gKO]{Volatile Creations}
Additional Info

Gain a Social quality at d10.

Archetype

Roll d10, d8, d6 for archetype selection.
